\section[la mer]{la mer — the sea}

\label{lesson:FR-C82-mer}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the French for a mountain, then the French for a river.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: la mer}
\textbf{la mer} — \textquotedblleft{}the sea\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{mer} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{mare}, \textquotedblleft{}sea\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1) — inherited: Latin's stressed \emph{a} became \emph{e}.
\end{cousinweb}
